name: Tenshi Dakara.
source:
Sism, an angel system who fights demons,
continues to fight despite being broken and in pain,
scorned and hated by the people he protects.

One day, Sism takes an interest in me and tries to get my attention with a carrier pigeon...

A slightly twisted love story.
translation:
Sism，一个与恶魔战斗的天使系统，
尽管受伤和痛苦，但仍继续战斗，
受到他所保护的人的蔑视和憎恨。

有一天，西斯姆对我产生了兴趣，并试图用一只信鸽引起我的注意……

一个略显扭曲的爱情故事。
